revisions.observation: Immutable initial matrix; the first focused replay exposed the observed warning-order boundary and two fixtures that violated the single-entry-point compilation contract.
Immutable second matrix; V05 records the observed MQ5023-before-MQ5022 order and C07/V10 are single-query reachability fixtures preserving the original obligations.
Final immutable matrix; P07 uses an equivalent source alias after the required full-gate cache-key collision replay, preserving the inactive set-modifier oracle and all 48 cases.

focusedReplay.coverage: The permanent matrix executes all 48 final cases across four 12-case families; it checks exact diagnostic codes, warning phase/source/severity/location, syntax-only quietness, runnable compilation, equivalent-rewrite stability and warning-only runtime value preservation.

semanticChecks.reachability: Live transitive CTE and let dependencies, nested live scopes, scalar subqueries and synthesized/internal structures remain quiet; dead authored chains receive bounded MQ5022 and MQ5023 warnings, while script parameters are not treated as lets.
semanticChecks.branchProofBoundary: Literal NULL, nullable, dynamic and uncertain CASE/coalesce alternatives remain quiet; deterministic false branches, true tails and proven non-null fallbacks receive only the documented MQ5008 warning.
semanticChecks.precedence: Specific MQ5008 branch advisories remain ahead of generic MQ5010/MQ5011 proof messages for the same source region, while independent regions retain their own warnings.
semanticChecks.inactiveCodes: Retired style and set-modifier compatibility identifiers remain un-emitted across ORDER BY, UNION and slicing forms, while active MQ5010 and MQ5011 controls remain available.
semanticChecks.runtimePreservation: Warning-only compilation preserves the convenience compilation result rows, columns and source behavior exactly.

productionFindings.observation: A literal-NULL CASE condition received MQ5008 even though it is not a statically provable boolean branch, and a final CASE ELSE after a proven-true condition did not receive the required unreachable warning.
productionFindings.rootCause: AnalyzeCase treated every successful static evaluation other than boolean true as a false or unknown branch and only reported unreachable WHEN tails, so non-boolean values exceeded the proof boundary and a final ELSE was omitted.
productionFindings.resolution: Only statically evaluated boolean values now participate in unreachable-branch proofs; null and non-boolean values remain quiet, and a proven-true condition reports its final ELSE once as the unreachable region.

notes: Revisions 1 and 2 remain immutable; revision 3 records the cache-key isolation correction after both required full-gate attempts and the isolated cache-reuse replay passed 1/1.
REC-119-F01 is limited to the documented boolean proof boundary and final-ELSE reachability; it does not add coercion or infer null and dynamic values.
The final source and test payload remained unchanged after the authoritative full gate; administrative evidence, report, ledger and progress updates are outside the tested payload boundary.
